calls.title: Anderson Chung and James Shannon
calls.summary: The meeting aimed to outline necessary enterprise-grade features for Growth Book's self-hosted setup. Key requirements included approval workflows for nearly 1,000 feature flags to enhance safety and efficiency, audit logs and encryption for accountability and security, and the need for role-based access control involving about 40 operational and 80 view-only seats. Additional discussions covered the necessity for multiple webhook connections to manage environment separation and seamless upgrade mechanisms for enterprise capacities. The team also addressed pricing concerns, with a preliminary estimate around $76,250 annually, while seeking a 50% discount to fit budget constraints. Experimentation expansions were highlighted, including anonymous user support and integration with data monitoring tools.
calls.keywords: Feature flags, Approval workflows, Enterprise licensing, Experiment platform, Audit logs, Encryption
calls.action_items:
**James Shannon**
Send documentation on encrypted SDK payload to Anderson Chung to address security concerns (15:10)
Provide specific pricing details for view-only seats and an updated quote including the requested discount to Swag team (28:49)
Schedule and conduct a follow-up call on Tuesday to present revised pricing and discuss next steps with Swag team (30:25)
Explore possibility of negotiating a 50% discount with Growth Book management contingent on contract signing before end of June (29:08)

**Anderson Chung**
Review pricing details and prepare internal case for budget approval based on productivity gains from enterprise features (16:25)
Confirm internal readiness and timeline to decide on contract within one week (25:28)
Participate in scheduled follow-up call on Tuesday to review updated pricing and discuss next steps (30:39)
